Risk_Title: Unresolved Spatial Support Mismatch at Flanders Bay Gate
Impact_Description: Discrete 500 m cell 28 is offset by +167 m downstream in a steep deceleration zone (g_parallel = -0.56 yr^-1). Interpolated model velocity at the exact gate is 269.6 m/yr vs obs 210 +- 12 m/yr (+4.97 sigma). Tuning C_bed to 210 m/yr at cell 28 without sub-grid resolution would bake a 94 m/yr spatial bias into bedrock friction.
Mitigation_Strategy: Formally mark Flanders gate comparison support UNRESOLVED at 500 m grid resolution. Strictly PROHIBIT tuning C_bed to the 210 m/yr observation until sub-grid resolution or explicit gate cross-section line integration is implemented.

Risk_Title: Conflation of Local Numerical Rank with Global Uniqueness
Impact_Description: Full numerical rank of local Jacobian J(m_0) only proves local non-singularity, not global uniqueness across non-linear parameter space.
Mitigation_Strategy: Explicitly distinguish local numerical rank, local conditioning, practical identifiability, and global uniqueness. Document that global uniqueness is unproven for non-linear SSA models.
